name: What preparations should I make before a professional arrives to install a new faucet?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before a professional arrives to install a new faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a professional arrives for faucet installation, clear the area under the sink and around the sink basin to ensure easy access. Remove any cleaning supplies, garbage cans, or stored items. Ensure the water supply valves under the sink are accessible and can be easily turned off. If you have the new faucet already, have it readily available for the installer. Inform the professional of any known issues or concerns about your current plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before faucet installation, clear the under-sink area, ensure water shut-off valves are accessible, and have the new faucet ready for the installer.
